correctness.rationale: Lemma for |G|<=16 verified by inspection: transitive degree-8 orders are 8 or 16, stabilizers 1 or 2, and intersecting pairs force coset structure; edge cases (singletons, 1-sets vs maxima) handled. All archived groups re-checked from groups.json by independent code: closure under composition/inverse, identity present, transitivity (orb(0)=8), stabilizer orders 1/3/4/6/8/7/48. Agreement-graph maxima re-proved: G24 omega=3 by brute C(24,3)=2024 (128 cliques) plus C(24,4) empty plus independent BB omega=3; G32 omega=4 by brute C(32,4) (16 cliques, all canonical) plus no 5-clique plus BB; G48 omega=6 by two BB codes plus independent counting recursion (32 cliques, listed==stars); GW64 omega=8 by two BB codes plus independent count (1024); AGL(1,8) omega=7 by two independent BB codes (compute.py color-sort BB and verify.py degeneracy BB plus auditor third BB). Witnesses [12,21,22] (G24), [48,56,57,58,59,60,61,62] (GW64), [48-54] (AGL) each verified pairwise-intersecting and not in star set (all 8*|Gx| cosets enumerated). Primitivity/block claims re-checked: AGL has no block containing 0, others have blocks, AGL is 2-transitive Frobenius (stab fixes only base point). DRAFT honestly disclaims full 50-class census and calls isomorphism labels descriptive; size equalities use cited rho=1 theorem as background plus exact computation, not misrepresented as proof of rho=1.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively, not by timestamp: Hujdurovic et al. 2104.04699 proves rho=1 for prime-power degree (hence max size |G|/8 for degree 8) but does not decide canonicity; Hujdurovic et al. 2108.03943 defines strict-EKR and studies direct/wreath products (including IS-primitive/MIS-normal criteria and regular-top wreath structure) but gives no degree-8 verdict table or explicit non-canonical witnesses; Ahmadi-Meagher 1311.7060 proves cyclic strict-EKR, dihedral/Frobenius characterization (Frobenius strict iff |H|=2), and EKR preservation under products, but no enumeration over transitive degree-8 class; Pantangi 2311.13055 proves 3-transitive strict-EKR (covers e.g. AGL(3,2)) but none of the headline models (orders 24/32/48/64/56, imprimitive or 2-transitive Frobenius) fall in that family. Live arXiv API strict-EKR query returns 6 hits, none a degree-8 census; derangement/intersection-density queries return no degree-8 table. TransGrp/GAP stores bare representatives, not clique certificates. Note: AGL(1,8) strict-failure alone follows from the known Frobenius criterion (|H|=7>2), so that sub-verdict is theorem-implied, but the headline fallback (G24 S4-on-3-cycles failure with 128/32 counts; GW64 C2-wr-V4 failure with 1024/32 counts; G32/G48 strict-hold) is not implied by any triaged theorem and no source tabulates these exact counts/witnesses.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from unfinished 50-class survey, which DRAFT honestly disclaims. The certified fragment (two strict-hold imprimitive models with exact all-maxima counts 16 and 32; two strict-failure models with exact counts 128/1024 and explicit non-canonical witnesses; plus primitive AGL(1,8) failure witness with omega=7 certificate) is a rigorously established exact invariant of natural objects (transitive degree-8 groups) motivated before computation by the Meagher/Hujdurovic strict-canonicity and direct/wreath-product program. Values were not known or mechanically implied (except AGL verdict, whose explicit witness remains new), and future work on wreath-product maxima needs precisely such citable witnesses/counts. This is an extremal-witness/counterexample fragment, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: every witness is interpreted as a star-membership failure with maximality log.

decisive_checks: Rebuilt closure/transitivity/stabilizer orders from archived permutations only: C8/24/32/48/64/56/384 transitive with stab 1/3/4/6/8/7/48.
G24: brute C(24,3)=2024 gives 128 cliques, C(24,4) gives 0, canonical among maxima 32; independent BB omega=3; witness [12,21,22] clique and non-star.
G32: brute C(32,4) gives 16 cliques all canonical, no 5-clique; independent BB omega=4.
G48: independent BB omega=6 and independent counting recursion gives 32; listed cliques equal star set; nonstars 0.
GW64: independent BB omega=8 and independent count 1024; witness [48,56,57,58,59,60,61,62] pairwise agreements listed, non-star; all 8 perms derangements except pairwise intersections verified.

AGL18: independent BB omega=7 (third code path); witness [48-54] clique and non-star; distinct stars 64; stabilizer acts fixed-point-freely off base point (Frobenius); 2-transitive and block-free verified.
Lemma |G|<=16 proof checked for both orders 8 and 16 including singleton/coset boundary.
residual_risks: AGL(1,8) failure verdict alone is implied by Ahmadi-Meagher Frobenius criterion; novelty there rests on explicit witness and omega certificate, not the bare verdict.

Isomorphism labels (S4, S4xC2, C2 wr V4, AGL(1,8)) are descriptive per DRAFT; identity rests on explicit generators plus verified numerical invariants, not certified isomorphism.
